description: Source code implementing buffer memory management functions for OpenSSL, including creation, freeing, resizing, appending, and duplication of buffer structures.

methods.name: BUF_MEM_new
methods.description: Creates a new BUF_MEM structure with allocated memory.

methods.name: BUF_MEM_free
methods.description: Frees a BUF_MEM structure and its data.

methods.name: BUF_MEM_reserve
methods.description: Reserves capacity in BUF_MEM, reallocating if necessary.

methods.name: BUF_MEM_grow
methods.description: Grows the buffer to a specified length, zero-initializing new space.

methods.name: BUF_MEM_grow_clean
methods.description: Alias for BUF_MEM_grow, provided for clarity.

methods.name: BUF_MEM_append
methods.description: Appends data to the buffer, resizing as needed.

methods.name: BUF_strdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string using OpenSSL's memory functions.

methods.name: BUF_strnlen
methods.description: Calculates string length up to a maximum length.

methods.name: BUF_strndup
methods.description: Duplicates a string up to a specified size.

methods.name: BUF_strlcpy
methods.description: Copies a string with size limit.

methods.name: BUF_strlcat
methods.description: Concatenates a string with size limit.
